name: tokenxiety
description: Unofficial new tab dashboard for your own AI chat rate-limit usage. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
author: pg@backend.how

scripts.syntax: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.manifest: python3 -m json.tool manifest.json >/dev/null && python3 scripts/check-manifest.py manifest.json
scripts.validate: npm run manifest && npm run syntax && npm test
scripts.build: rm -rf dist/tokenxiety dist/tokenxiety-quota-tab dist/tokenxiety.zip && mkdir -p dist/tokenxiety && cp manifest.json dist/tokenxiety/ && cp -R src dist/tokenxiety/src && find dist/tokenxiety \( -name '.DS_Store' -o -name '._*' -o -name 'Thumbs.db' \) -delete && cp -R dist/tokenxiety dist/tokenxiety-quota-tab && python3 scripts/make-zip.py dist/tokenxiety dist/tokenxiety.zip && echo built dist/tokenxiety
